_note: Line 3 ('chore: bump eslint') is attributed to R-05, not R-04. Conventional-commit prefixes now run ahead of the token heuristics, so the author's own `chore:` declaration wins over an incidental match on the word 'eslint'. The classification is NOISE either way; only the cited rule changed. That ordering is what stops `feat: add dashboard widget` being buried as INTERNAL by the word 'dashboard'.
